people.name: First Adzom Drukpa, Drodul Pawo Dorje

relations.subject: Sera Khandro Kunzang Dekyong Wangmo
relations.evidence: to follow the Vajrayana teacher Drime Ozer, who was then in Lhasa on pilgrimage from Golok in Eastern Tibet. She returned with him and his students to Golok

relations.subject: Dudjom Rinpoche
relations.evidence: She taught Dudjom Rinpoche, Chatral Rinpoche, and the First Adzom Drukpa, Drodul Pawo Dorje, among other high lamas.
